name: Santa Marta de Tormes (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a blue saltire fimbriated white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santa Marta de Tormes (crossed keys on blue above waves).
history: The arms of Santa Marta de Tormes were approved on 24 July 1992, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 11 January 1994; the municipal flag, approved on the same date, is rectangular, yellow with a blue saltire, on which the arms of the municipality may be placed.
